basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and a part-time barista living in Seattle. Originally from a small town in the Midwest, I moved here less than a year ago to experience the vibrant city life. I'm fascinated by urban legends and crime history, which is why you'll often find me lurking in subreddits related to mystery and true crime. In my spare time, I enjoy writing haikus, exploring the city's coffee culture, and practicing mindfulness. Typically online during late evenings after work. Single and enjoying the journey of self-discovery.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a general interest in crime stories and urban myths, mostly self-taught through documentaries and books. My knowledge is broad rather than deep, often picking up bits and pieces from various online discussions and articles.
